series.name: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)
series.notes: Three-phase C&I string inverter. Manual note: 'The models you purchased may only contain some of the fault information listed therein.' Codes here are the KTLX-G3P table ONLY; the near-identical ID0xx numbers on 100-125KTLX-G4, HYD and ME carry different names/solutions and are kept in their own series. Not merged.

meaning.en: Measured grid voltage is above the inverter's over-voltage trip window. Usually self-clears when the grid settles.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage inverter ki over-voltage limit se upar hai. Aam tor par grid theek hone par khud clear ho jata hai.

causes.en: DISCO/grid voltage surge or a badly timed neighbour transformer tap.
causes.ur: DISCO ya grid ka voltage surge, ya kisi transformer ka tap setting kharab.

causes.en: AC contactor or breaker not fully closed / contact resistance too high.
causes.ur: AC contactor ya breaker poora close nahi hua, ya contact resistance zyada hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage with a multimeter at the inverter AC terminal; expect it inside the local DISCO window.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se inverter ke AC terminal par grid voltage check karein; reading local DISCO window ke andar honi chahiye.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, then check AC input cable, breaker and earth continuity.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karein, phir AC cable, breaker aur earth continuity check karein.

solutions.en: If readings are correct but the alarm repeats, log the event and raise with DISCO - do not change protection setpoints yourself.
solutions.ur: Agar reading theek hai phir bhi alarm repeat ho, event log karke DISCO ko report karein - protection setpoint khud na badlein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

meaning.en: Grid voltage is below the under-voltage trip window, so the inverter disconnects from the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage under-voltage limit se neeche gir gaya, is liye inverter grid se disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Long distribution feeder with heavy load - voltage sags under AC motor start.
causes.ur: Lambi distribution line par heavy load - AC motor start par voltage sag.

causes.en: AC wiring loose or undersized, high contact drop on breaker.
causes.ur: AC wiring loose ya choti, breaker par contact drop zyada.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage with a multimeter at the AC terminal under load; check the sag.
solutions.ur: Load ke saath AC terminal par multimeter se grid voltage check karein; sag dekhein.

solutions.en: Power off the DC switch and AC breaker, then re-torque all AC connections.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker power off karein, phir sab AC connections dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: If voltage at the meter is also low, this is a supply problem - escalate to DISCO, inverter is fine.
solutions.ur: Agar meter par bhi voltage kam hai to yeh supply ka masla hai - DISCO ko batayein, inverter theek hai.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

meaning.en: Grid frequency is above the permitted window, so the inverter reduces or stops output.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency allowed range se upar hai, is liye inverter output kam kar deta hai ya band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Utility frequency excursion - common during load shedding restoration on a weak feeder.
causes.ur: Utility ka frequency excursion - kamzor feeder par load shedding ke baad aksar hota hai.

causes.en: Generator/ESS on the same bus pushing frequency up while grid-tied.
causes.ur: Same bus par generator ya ESS grid se jude hote hue frequency upar push kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Check grid frequency with a multimeter or frequency meter at the AC terminal; expect 50 Hz +/- allowed band.
solutions.ur: AC terminal par multimeter ya frequency meter se grid frequency check karein; 50 Hz +/- allowed band hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Confirm the AC breaker is not chattering and the grid connection is clean.
solutions.ur: Yeh confirm karein ke AC breaker chatter nahi kar raha aur grid connection saaf hai.

solutions.en: If a generator is running, check its governor/frequency setting before blaming the inverter.
solutions.ur: Agar generator chal raha hai, to inverter par blame lagane se pehle uska governor aur frequency setting check karein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

meaning.en: Grid frequency is below the permitted window; the inverter stops exporting to the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency allowed range se neeche hai; inverter grid mein export karna band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Weak feeder / long cable run with heavy inductive load causing frequency droop.
causes.ur: Kamzor feeder ya lambi cable par heavy inductive load, jis se frequency gir jata hai.

causes.en: Oversized solar export on a small local grid pushing frequency down.
causes.ur: Chhote local grid par zyada solar export, jis se frequency neeche chala jata hai.

solutions.en: Measure frequency at the AC terminal with a frequency meter; log the value and time.
solutions.ur: AC terminal par frequency meter se frequency measure karein; value aur time note karein.

solutions.en: Reduce PV array size or use export limiting if the site regularly drags frequency down.
solutions.ur: Agar site par baar baar frequency girta hai to PV array size kam karein ya export limiting lagayein.

solutions.en: Raise the under-frequency protection point only with written approval from the grid operator.
solutions.ur: Under-frequency protection point sirf grid operator ki written approval se hi badlein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

meaning.en: The residual-current sensor measured leakage above the allowed level, so the inverter shut down. This is the main earth-fault code on this model.
meaning.ur: Residual current sensor ne allowed level se zyada leakage measure kiya, is liye inverter band ho gaya. Is model ka main earth-fault code yehi hai.

causes.en: PV array insulation breakdown from moisture, soiling or a damaged module / cable.
causes.ur: PV array ki insulation moisture, ghar ya kisi damaged module/cable ki wajah se kharab ho gayi.

causes.en: Damaged or pinched DC cable, or a junction box with moisture inside.
causes.ur: Damaged ya pinch hua DC cable, ya andar geela hua junction box.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch and AC breaker and wait 5 minutes before touching any DC wiring.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker open karein aur DC wiring chhoone se pehle 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Measure insulation resistance of each PV string to earth with a 1000 V megger; expect megaohms, not low readings.
solutions.ur: Har PV string ka earth ke saath insulation resistance 1000 V megger se check karein; reading megaohm honi chahiye, kam nahi.

solutions.en: Isolate strings one by one to find the offending string, then inspect connectors, MC4 and the module backs for water ingress.
solutions.ur: Strings ko ek ek karke isolate karein takay galti wali string mil jaye, phir connectors, MC4 aur module ke peeche paani ki dhalai dekhhein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

title.ur: Island protection error - grid chala gaya (ID008)

meaning.en: The inverter detected that the grid is no longer present while it was still exporting, and correctly locked out. Do not defeat this protection.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne dekha ke grid chala gaya hai magar woh abhi bhi export kar raha tha, is liye khud band ho gaya. Yeh protection kabhi bypass na karein.

causes.en: Genuine outage - grid breaker tripped, transformer fuse blown, or local fault.
causes.ur: Asli outage - grid breaker trip hua, transformer ka fuse uthha, ya local fault hua.

causes.en: Brief AC contact dropout from a loose breaker or chattering supply.
causes.ur: Loose breaker ya supply chatter ki wajah se AC contact ka chhota gap.

solutions.en: Confirm the outage at the utility breaker and at the site AC isolator before touching the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter chhoone se pehle utility breaker aur site AC isolator par outage confirm karein.

solutions.en: Once grid is stable, switch AC breaker then DC switch on and watch the LCD restart sequence.
solutions.ur: Grid stable hone ke baad AC breaker aur phir DC switch on karein aur LCD ka restart sequence dekhein.

solutions.en: If islanding trips repeatedly with a healthy grid, inspect AC wiring and CT/meter setup with the installer.
solutions.ur: Grid theek hone par bhi islanding baar baar trip ho to AC wiring aur CT/meter setup installer se check karwayein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

meaning.en: A short, fast grid voltage spike was caught by the ride-through logic; the inverter survives and self-recovers.
meaning.ur: Grid mein chhota aur tez voltage spike ride-through logic ne pakra; inverter bach jata hai aur khud recover ho jata hai.

causes.en: Switching of large capacitor banks or transformers on the local feeder.
causes.ur: Local feeder par bade capacitor bank ya transformer ka on/off hona.

causes.en: Energising the grid breaker with the inverter already connected.
causes.ur: Inverter pehle se jude hote hue grid breaker energise karna.

solutions.en: Note the timestamp; a single event with no load impact is normal ride-through behaviour.
solutions.ur: Timestamp note karein; agar ek baar hua aur load par asar nahi, to ye normal ride-through behaviour hai.

solutions.en: If events cluster at a specific time, correlate with feeder switching by the utility.
solutions.ur: Agar events ek khaas time par repeat hote hain to utility se feeder switching se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC SPD / surge protection status and replace the module if the MOV has gone.
solutions.ur: AC SPD / surge protection ki status check karein aur MOV kharab ho to module replace karein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

title.ur: Grid line voltage error - grid line ka voltage galat (ID011)

meaning.en: The inverter could not read a usable grid line voltage on all three phases and shut down to stay safe.
meaning.ur: Inverter teeno phase par proper grid line voltage nahi parh saka aur safety ke liye band ho gaya.

causes.en: One phase missing or a blown fuse in the inverter AC input board.
causes.ur: Ek phase missing ya inverter ke AC input board par koi fuse uthha hua.

causes.en: Loose L1/L2/L3 lug, or a tripped AC breaker on one pole only.
causes.ur: L1/L2/L3 lug loose, ya sirf ek pole ka AC breaker trip hua.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, then check all three phase fuses and the AC busbar connections.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karein, phir teeno phase ke fuse aur AC busbar connections check karein.

solutions.en: Measure each phase to neutral with a multimeter; expect three balanced readings.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se har phase ka neutral ke saath reading lein; teen balanced readings aani chahiye.

solutions.en: If one phase reads zero, replace that fuse - do not jumper it, and never work on the live busbar.
solutions.ur: Agar ek phase ki reading zero hai to woh fuse replace karein - jumper na lagayein, aur live busbar par kabhi kaam na karein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

title.ur: Feed-in limitation / anti-reflux fault - grid mein power wapas ja raha hai (ID013)

meaning.en: The zero-export / feed-in limitation function is not working, so the inverter has stopped to avoid pushing power back to the grid.
meaning.ur: Zero-export / feed-in limitation function kaam nahi kar raha, is liye inverter grid mein power wapas bhejne se bachne ke liye ruk gaya.

causes.en: Smart meter or CT not communicating, so export limit is not measured.
causes.ur: Smart meter ya CT communicate nahi kar raha, is liye export limit measure nahi hoti.

causes.en: Zero-export threshold set to 0 W with a CT that is not installed or not oriented correctly.
causes.ur: Zero-export threshold 0 W par set hai magar CT lagi hui nahi ya ghalat direction mein hai.

solutions.en: Check the monitoring platform for the meter/CT online status; a red offline flag points straight at this code.
solutions.ur: Monitoring platform par meter/CT ki online status dekhein; laal offline flag is code ki taraf ishara karta hai.

solutions.en: Power off and verify the CT clamp direction arrow matches the grid flow direction, and that the CT lead is in the CT port.
solutions.ur: Power off karke CT clamp ki arrow grid flow ke direction se match karwayein, aur CT lead CT port mein honi chahiye.

solutions.en: If a smart meter is used instead, re-enter the meter modbus address and confirm the meter is on the same RS485 bus.
solutions.ur: Agar smart meter use ho raha hai to meter ka modbus address dobara daal kar confirm karein ke meter usi RS485 bus par hai.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

meaning.en: The inverter's internal self-test of the output relay failed at startup, so it refuses to connect to the grid.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne startup par apne output relay ka internal self-test fail kiya, is liye grid se connect nahi hota.

causes.en: Output relay contacts welded or coil damaged from a previous overcurrent event.
causes.ur: Pehle ke overcurrent event se output relay ke contacts juce hue ya coil kharab.

causes.en: Relay PCB driver or the relay detection circuit faulty.
causes.ur: Relay PCB driver ya relay detection circuit kharab.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker and wait 5 minutes, then do one clean restart to rule out a false trip.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karein, 5 minute wait karein, phir ek baar saaf restart karke dekh lein ke false trip to nahi.

solutions.en: With power off, check the relay connector is fully seated on the board - reseat it if loose.
solutions.ur: Power off karke dekhein ke relay connector board par poora baitha hai - loose ho to dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: If the relay truly fails self-test on every restart, the relay module needs replacement by a SOFAR service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar har restart par relay self-test fail ho to relay module SOFAR service centre se replace karwana hoga.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

title.en: PV insulation too low / earth fault (ID042)

meaning.en: Insulation between the PV array and earth measured too low, so the inverter locked out. Treat as a live earth-fault until proven otherwise.
meaning.ur: PV array aur earth ke darmiyan insulation bahut kam nikla, is liye inverter lock out ho gaya. Jab tak sabit na ho, isay zinda earth-fault samajhein.

causes.en: PV array insulation breakdown from moisture - common after monsoon, roof seepage or heavy dew.
causes.ur: PV array ki insulation moisture se kharab - monsoon, chhat se paani ya bhaari oos ke baad aam hai.

causes.en: Cable pinched under a mounting rail, or a rodent-chewed cable.
causes.ur: Mounting rail ke neeche pinch hua cable, ya chuha ka kuchha hua cable.

solutions.en: Open DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then megger each PV string to earth at 1000 V.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker open karein, 5 minute wait karke har PV string ka earth ke saath 1000 V par megger lagayein.

solutions.en: Split the array and test half at a time to pinpoint the faulty string.
solutions.ur: Array ko do hisson mein baant kar aadha aadha test karein takay galti wali string mil jaye.

solutions.en: Replace the damaged cable or module and re-test; never re-energise with a low insulation reading.
solutions.ur: Damaged cable ya module replace karke dobara test karein; kam insulation reading par dobara current na dein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

title.ur: PE / earth conductor fault - earth wiring kharab (ID043)

meaning.en: The protective earth conductor check did not pass, so the inverter shut down. Manual action: check the AC output PE wire for grounding.
meaning.ur: Protective earth conductor ka check pass nahi hua, is liye inverter band ho gaya. Manual ka action: AC output PE wire ki grounding check karein.

causes.en: PE conductor disconnected or loose at the inverter earth terminal.
causes.ur: PE conductor inverter ke earth terminal se disconnect ya loose ho gaya.

causes.en: Earth bar not bonded, or the installer used the neutral instead of earth.
causes.ur: Earth bar bond nahi hai, ya installer ne earth ke bajaye neutral istemal kar diya.

solutions.en: Switch off DC and AC, then inspect the PE stud, its ring lug and the cable for corrosion or a loose bolt.
solutions.ur: DC aur AC off karke PE stud, uska ring lug aur cable ko corrosion ya loose bolt ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: Measure earth continuity from the inverter PE terminal to the site earth bar with a low-ohm meter; expect near zero.
solutions.ur: Low-ohm meter se inverter ke PE terminal se site earth bar tak earth continuity measure karein; reading zero ke qareeb honi chahiye.

solutions.en: If the ring lug is burnt or the bolt will not torque, replace the lug - do not just tighten a burnt connection.
solutions.ur: Agar ring lug jali hui ho ya bolt tight na ho to lug replace karein - jali hui connection sirf tighten na karein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

title.ur: Input mode setting error - MPPT mode ghalat (ID044)

meaning.en: The MPPT input mode is set wrong for the installed array, so the inverter refuses to run.
meaning.ur: MPPT input mode installed array ke mutabiq ghalat set hai, is liye inverter chalne se inkaar kar raha hai.

causes.en: Two MPPT inputs wired as parallel but the unit is set to independent mode (or vice versa).
causes.ur: Do MPPT inputs parallel se jure hain magar unit independent mode par set hai (ya ulta).

causes.en: Input mode setting lost after a firmware update or safety-parameter import.
causes.ur: Firmware update ya safety-parameter import ke baad input mode setting khoj gayi.

solutions.en: Count how many PV strings are physically connected to each MPPT port before changing any setting.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi setting badalne se pehle gino ke har MPPT port par kitni PV strings lagi hain.

solutions.en: If both MPPTs have strings, set the mode to parallel; if only one MPPT has strings, set it to independent.
solutions.ur: Agar dono MPPT par strings hain to parallel set karein; agar sirf ek MPPT par strings hain to independent set karein.

solutions.en: Re-check the mode after every firmware update or country-code import and confirm production resumes.
solutions.ur: Har firmware update ya country-code import ke baad mode dobara check karein aur production shuru hone ki tasdeeq karein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

meaning.en: Internal temperature is too high so the inverter has throttled its output. Not a hard fault - it produces less until it cools.
meaning.ur: Internal temperature zyada hai is liye inverter ne output kam kar diya hai. Ye hard fault nahi - thandi hone tak power kam rahegi.

causes.en: Direct sunlight on the inverter - common on a rooftop install in summer.
causes.ur: Inverter par direct sunlight - summer mein rooftop install par aam hai.

causes.en: Heat sink blocked by dust, or fans failed and not spinning.
causes.ur: Heat sink par dhool ki parat, ya fans chalu nahi ho rahe.

solutions.en: Check whether the heat sink and fan vents are clear of dust, cobwebs or stored items.
solutions.ur: Dekhein ke heat sink aur fan vents par dhool, makdiya ya rakhi hui cheezein to nahi hain.

solutions.en: Measure the heat sink surface with an IR thermometer; compare with the LCD temperature reading.
solutions.ur: IR thermometer se heat sink ki surface temperature check karein; LCD reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the unit is in direct sun, add a shade hood and increase clearance; check fan ID169 next.
solutions.ur: Agar unit direct sun mein hai to shade hood lagayein aur clearance barhayein; agla fan code ID169 dekhein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

meaning.en: The AC output hardware overcurrent protection latched into an unrecoverable state - the manual's name says 'permanent failure'. Inverter will not restart on its own.
meaning.ur: AC output hardware overcurrent protection permanent state mein chala gaya - manual ke naam ke mutabiq 'permanent failure'. Inverter khud restart nahi hoga.

causes.en: Severe or repeated AC overload - load far beyond inverter rating, or a shorted load.
causes.ur: Bara ya baar baar AC overload - load inverter rating se kaafi upar, ya short circuit wala load.

causes.en: Damaged current sensing circuit or the inverter internal output stage.
causes.ur: Current sensing circuit ya inverter ka internal output stage kharab.

solutions.en: Open AC breaker and confirm the connected load is within rated output power before re-energising anything.
solutions.ur: AC breaker open karein aur kuch bhi dobara on karne se pehle confirm karein ke connected load rated output power ke andar hai.

solutions.en: Measure each phase current with a clamp meter and compare against the datasheet maximum; find and unplug the offending load.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se har phase ka current measure karein aur datasheet maximum se compare karein; galti wala load dhoondh kar nikalein.

solutions.en: If load is within rating and the code returns, the internal output stage is damaged - raise a warranty case with the SOFAR service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar load rating ke andar hai phir bhi code aaye to internal output stage kharab hai - SOFAR service centre ke saath warranty case karein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

title.ur: USB port fault - USB kaam nahi kar raha (ID145)

meaning.en: The inverter's USB port or the inserted drive is not working - typically raised during a firmware update attempt. Manual action: check the USB port.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka USB port ya us mein lagi drive kaam nahi kar rahi - aam tor par firmware update ki koshish par aata hai. Manual ka action: USB port check karein.

causes.en: USB drive formatted wrong (not FAT32) or a drive with a marginal connector.
causes.ur: USB drive galat format ki hui hai (FAT32 nahi) ya connector wala drive.

causes.en: Firmware file copied outside the required 'firmware' subfolder.
causes.ur: Firmware file gharah folder ke bahar copy ki gayi hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the DC switch, then re-seat and inspect the USB port and drive for bent pins or debris.
solutions.ur: DC switch off karke USB port aur drive ko dobara baithayein aur tange pins ya gaddon ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: Reformat the drive as FAT32 and place the update file inside the folder named firmware, as the manual requires.
solutions.ur: Drive ko FAT32 mein dobara format karein aur update file manual ke mutabiq firmware naam ke folder ke andar rakhein.

solutions.en: Never update firmware with AC live or PV connected - switch both off first.
solutions.ur: AC live ya PV connected hone par firmware kabhi update na karein - dono pehle off karein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

title.ur: Cooling fan 1 fault - fan chalu nahi (ID169)

meaning.en: Fan 1 is not spinning or its tach feedback is missing, so the inverter has lost that cooling path. This model numbers fans individually: ID169-ID175.
meaning.ur: Fan 1 ghoch nahi raha ya us ka feedback nahi aa raha, is liye inverter ne woh cooling chala diya. Is model mein fans alag alag number hote hain: ID169-ID175.

causes.en: Dust-packed fan blades or a fan obstructed by a cable or insect nest.
causes.ur: Fan blades par dhool ki parat ya cable/keeda ke ghere se fan ruka hua.

causes.en: Failed fan motor bearing, or the fan cable connector has come out of the fan baseboard.
causes.ur: Fan motor ka bearing kharab, ya fan cable connector fan baseboard se nikal gaya.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter fully, then hold a tissue strip at the vent to confirm zero airflow.
solutions.ur: Inverter ko poori tarah power off karke vent par tissue rakh kar zero airflow ki tasdeeq karein.

solutions.en: Open the fan baseboard, unplug the fan connector and clean the blades with a soft brush as the manual describes.
solutions.ur: Fan baseboard kholein, fan connector nikaal kar blades ko soft brush se saaf karein jaise manual mein bataya gaya hai.

solutions.en: If the fan does not spin freely after cleaning, replace it - a stopped fan will escalate into ID113 derating.
solutions.ur: Agar saaf karne ke baad bhi fan freely na ghoome to replace karein - ruka hua fan ID113 derating tak le jayega.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list
